newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks slump on profit-taking in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks slump on profit-taking in late trade.

text.p: The Mexican bourse reined in earlier losses but was still off on profit-taking in slow mid-afternoon dealing on Friday, dealers said.
"We've recovered a little, with some dealers taking advantage of prices to change positions, but apart from that they're getting ready for the weekend," a desk trader said.
The leading IPC share index was down 26.43 points, or 0.59 percent, at 4,833.96.
Volume was much slower than for many recent sessions at 61.3 million shares. Dealers said the market was "taking a breather" after eight straight record closes.
